BotPersona.title: BotPersona
BotPersona.description: User-configured floating Mote AI assistant persona synced across devices.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user.

name.description: Display name of the bot persona (1-50 chars).

role.description: Short role description of the bot (1-80 chars).

colorHex.description: ARGB color integer representing the bot theme color.

active.description: Whether this bot persona is currently active.

inferenceMode.description: Preferred AI routing mode for the bot.

systemPrompt.description: System instruction guiding the bot's Generative UI output (1-1000 chars).

allowScreenRead.description: Whether the bot is permitted to read redacted screen context.

allowActions.description: Whether the bot is permitted to suggest device control actions.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation and update.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Single user prompt or assistant response entry displayed in the FloatingAssistantView chat history.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user.

botId.description: Identifier of the bot persona handling the message (1-128 chars).

botName.description: Display name of the bot persona (1-50 chars).

engineUsed.description: Inference engine label for assistant responses, or NONE for user prompts.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

/users/{userId}/bots/{botId}.description: Per-user collection of Mote bot personas.

/users/{userId}/chatHistory/{messageId}.description: Per-user FloatingAssistantView conversation history keyed by user UID.
